title: NovaPay Core Platform & Fees
content: NovaPay Solutions Ltd offers cross-border and local payment gateway APIs. Standard transaction fees are 1.4% for domestic transactions capped at 2000 NGN, and 3.8% for international transactions. Payout and settlement schedules for registered merchants occur on a T+1 business day basis.

title: Merchant Onboarding & KYC
content: To onboard as a registered merchant on NovaPay, businesses must submit a valid CAC certificate, verified Tax Identification Number (TIN), business bank account details, and proof of address. Tier 1 verification takes 24 to 48 business hours.

title: Dispute Resolution & Chargebacks
content: Merchants have 72 hours to respond to chargeback claims through the NovaPay Merchant Dashboard. Failure to provide transaction evidence within 72 hours results in an automated refund to the cardholder.

title: API Webhooks & Integration
content: NovaPay sends webhook events for transaction.successful, charge.failed, and refund.processed. Webhooks must return an HTTP 200 OK within 5 seconds. Signatures are verified using HMAC SHA512 with the merchant's secret key.

title: Security & Compliance Standards
content: NovaPay maintains PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance, ISO 27001 certification, and enforces end-to-end AES-256 encryption on all stored card data and sensitive API tokens.
